title: Your mistake
text: Your mistake has just led to a goal for the other team.

options.text: Shake it off, focus on the next action
options.why: Mistakes happen to everyone. The next action is the one you can control.

options.text: Keep out of the way so you can't do it again
Go and say sorry to your keeper and team
options.why: Owning up is good, but keep it quick. Say "My fault", then get your head back in the game.
